desc: Canonically map boundary points to circular perimeter coordinates and establish the Manhattan/circular-separation equivalence for candidate distances d <= side.
Prove the optimum is at most side for k >= 4.
Validate the O(n*k) circular-spacing feasibility predicate, including successor jumps and wraparound, by samples and adversarial edge cases.
Provide the complete Python implementation compatible with the starter code, with correctness proof and complexity bounds.
